ranks: The need-keys recheck list R4 (Phase 1 step 2)

authored.name: Disciple of Freyalise // Garden of Freyalise

blocked.name: Revival of the Ancestors
blocked.why: Chapter II distributes counters among targets, and a Saga chapter has no `divided` field, so the split can't be announced.

blocked.name: Vorinclex // The Grand Evolution
blocked.why: The Grand Evolution's chapter II distributes seven +1/+1 counters among targets: a Saga chapter has no `divided` field.

blocked.name: Vastwood Hydra
blocked.why: The dies trigger distributes its +1/+1 counters (as it last existed) among creatures chosen as it resolves, not targeted; `counters-divided` takes only targets and a fixed total.

blocked.name: Shatterskull Smashing // Shatterskull, the Hammer Pass
blocked.why: The card-level `divided` totals X but not 'twice X instead if X is 6 or more'.

blocked.name: Ureni, the Song Unending
blocked.why: A trigger's `divided.total` is a number, the trigger value or a turn stat, not 'the number of lands you control'.

blocked.name: Chandra, Awakened Inferno
blocked.why: The emblem is expressible, but the −X ability isn't: `loyaltyCost` is a number only.

blocked.name: Chandra, Dressed to Kill
blocked.why: The −7's 'you may cast red spells from among them' is judged on the spell as cast (its ruling); the impulse permission's filter is checked against the exiled card's front face.

blocked.name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound
blocked.why: The −3 grants a graveyard cast for the rest of the turn with normal timing and 'exile it instead'; `cast-now` casts on resolution and `grant-graveyard-cast` has no exile clause.

blocked.name: Kaya the Inexorable
blocked.why: The emblem casts a legendary spell from hand, graveyard or among cards you own in exile; `cast-now`'s `from` takes one zone and none is 'exile you own'.

blocked.name: Lolth, Spider Queen
blocked.why: The emblem's intervening-if is 'if that player lost less than 8 life this turn'; the `turn-stat` condition's `who` is only you, an opponent or any player.

blocked.name: Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
blocked.why: 'The first activated ability of an artifact you activate each turn costs {2} less' (mana abilities included): `abilityCostModification` has no first-each-turn form, unlike spells' `costModification`.

blocked.name: Kithkin Armor
blocked.why: Sacrifice the Aura: prevent the damage a chosen source would deal to the creature it enchanted (read after the sacrifice); `prevent-damage-from-chosen-source`'s `to` takes only 'you' or a target slot.

blocked.name: Tyvar Kell
blocked.why: The emblem's 'whenever you cast an Elf spell, it gains haste until end of turn' gives haste to the spell just cast, carried to the permanent; no effect acts on the trigger spell that way.

blocked.name: Doomsday Excruciator
blocked.why: `exile-from-library` with `allBut` exiles face up; the card exiles face down.

blocked.name: Mari, the Killing Quill
blocked.why: The hit-counter exile works, but the granted trigger's 'you may remove a hit counter from a card that player owns in exile; if you do…' has no effect.

blocked.name: Rousing Refrain
blocked.why: The self-suspend works (`give-suspend`), but `add-mana` can't count the cards in target opponent's hand.

blocked.name: Ghostway
blocked.why: Exile each creature you control and return them together at the beginning of the next end step: `flicker` takes target slots only, and `exile-all` has no linked delayed return.

blocked.name: Planar Guide
blocked.why: Exile all creatures and return them together at the next end step: no untargeted group flicker with a linked delayed return.

blocked.name: Nahiri's Resolve
blocked.why: Any number of chosen (not targeted) nontoken artifacts and creatures, returned together at your next upkeep; `choose-permanents` runs its `then` once per permanent.

blocked.name: Gilraen, Dúnedain Protector
blocked.why: 'You may return it now; if you don't, return it at the next end step with a vigilance and a lifelink counter' has no flicker shape.

blocked.name: Tolsimir, Midnight's Light
blocked.why: The block requirement is expressible, but 'if Tolsimir attacked this combat' is neither `attacking` (wrong once removed from combat) nor `attackedThisTurn` (wrong across extra combats).

blocked.name: Dream Harvest
blocked.why: Exile cards from each opponent's library until total mana value 5 or greater: no running-total stop.

blocked.name: Triple Triad
blocked.why: Each player exiles their top card; you may cast yours free, and each other one only if its mana value is less than yours: `impulse-exile` has no such comparison.

blocked.name: Jace's Machinations
blocked.why: Instant-speed loyalty exists only as a permanent's own static, never granted to your Jace planeswalkers until end of turn.

blocked.name: Clear the Land
blocked.why: Each player reveals the top five, puts the lands onto the battlefield tapped and exiles the rest; `look-and-choose`'s leftover has no plain exile.

blocked.name: Ao, the Dawn Sky
blocked.why: The built key added `totalManaValueAtMost` to `return-from-graveyard` only (Lively Dirge); `look-and-choose` has no total-mana-value cap.

blocked.name: Michelangelo's Technique
blocked.why: Up to two creature cards with total mana value 6 or less from the looked-at cards: no total-mana-value cap on `look-and-choose`.

blocked.name: Smelting Vat
blocked.why: A total-mana-value cap on `look-and-choose`, set by an amount (the sacrificed artifact's mana value).

blocked.name: Final Fortune
blocked.why: 'At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game': no delayed trigger at the extra turn's own end step (and none if the turn is skipped, its ruling).

blocked.name: Shay Cormac
blocked.why: `lose-keywords` takes Keyword strings; protection and ward aren't among them.

blocked.name: Empowered Autogenerator
blocked.why: Put a charge counter on it, then add X mana where X is its charge counters: `add-mana`'s `also` runs after the mana; a sequence stops being a mana ability.

blocked.name: Hall of the Bandit Lord
blocked.why: A creature spell cast with this mana gains haste for good (its ruling); `spellGains` grants only until end of turn.

blocked.name: Tyvar the Bellicose
blocked.why: No granted 'whenever a mana ability of this creature resolves' trigger carrying the amount produced; 'they gain deathtouch' needs the attack batch.

blocked.name: Zhur-Taa Druid
blocked.why: 'Whenever you tap this for mana, it deals 1 damage to each opponent': `tapped-for-mana` triggers are only triggered mana abilities (add-mana effects).

blocked.name: Koma, Cosmos Serpent
blocked.why: 'Sacrifice another Serpent: Choose one —' is a modal activated ability; modes with their own targets work only on triggered abilities.

blocked.name: Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
blocked.why: The counter move works, but 'can't be blocked by creatures your opponents control this turn' has no one-shot filtered form.

blocked.name: Tester of the Tangential
blocked.why: Move X +1/+1 counters, X paid for in a may before a reflexive trigger: `move-counters.amount` has no X.

blocked.name: Zack Fair
blocked.why: The counters part works, but nothing records which Equipment was attached to the sacrificed Zack.

blocked.name: Boros Battleshaper
blocked.why: 'Can't attack or block this combat' and 'attacks this combat if able' have no combat-length duration on `restrict`; only the block half has `thisCombat`.

blocked.name: Crashing Boars
blocked.why: The defending player chooses an untapped creature they control (not targeted); `choose-permanents` has no other-player chooser.

blocked.name: Feral Contest
blocked.why: Its ruling: if only the first target is illegal, the second still must block it; `block-if-able` drops the requirement when the attacker slot is illegal (blanked by 608.2b handling) though it's still on the battlefield.

blocked.name: Hunt Down
blocked.why: Target creature blocks target creature: if the second target becomes illegal but stays, the requirement should stay (as Feral Contest's ruling); `block-if-able` drops it.

blocked.name: Predatory Rampage
blocked.why: 'Each creature your opponents control blocks this turn if able', a rule for the turn binding creatures that enter later; `block-if-able` takes only a target.

blocked.name: You've Been Caught Stealing
blocked.why: The 'each creature blocks this turn if able' mode: `block-if-able` has no filter form.

blocked.name: Mark for Death
blocked.why: 'Other creatures that player controls can't block this turn': `restrict`'s filter form has no 'controlled by the target's controller, except the target'.

blocked.name: Torchling
blocked.why: 'Change the target of target spell that targets only this creature': the ruling says several targets at it all change to one new target; `change-targets` retargets each slot separately.

blocked.name: Absolute Virtue
blocked.why: 'You have protection from each of your opponents': no static player protection from players.

blocked.name: Dream Fracture
blocked.why: 'Its controller draws a card' for the countered spell: `draw` has only `who` or a player target.

blocked.name: Fade from History
blocked.why: 'Each player who controls an artifact or enchantment creates a 2/2 Bear': the `controls` condition always counts the source's controller.
